description:
jmap-types provides the `Id` newtype precisely so account/object identifiers don't go through arbitrary string handling. The workspace uses `Id` correctly in 52 sites but has 4 outliers using raw `String`:

(Subagent provided the count but not exact file:line locations. Need to grep for them.)

Action items:
1. `grep -rn "account_id: String" crate-*/src/` to find the offenders.
2. Change `String` → `Id` (or `jmap_types::Id`).
3. Update construction sites to use `Id::from` or `Id::try_from`.

Why P2: SemVer-affecting (changes a public field's type), and corrects a type-safety regression. `String` admits arbitrary bytes including spec-invalid characters; `Id` validates per RFC 8620 §1.2 (a-z A-Z 0-9 _ -).
title: P2: 4 sites use account_id: String while 52 sites correctly use Id
